training.headline: A plan shaped around your race.
training.lede: Set one clear target and Runwise will turn your real training history into a practical path to race day.
training.setupCopy: Add your race details and preferred days. Nothing is saved until you create the plan.
training.raceDateHint: The day you want to arrive ready.
training.trainingDaysHint: Choose 2–6 days and give each day a role.
training.goalRequired: Add a race date, distance, finish time, and at least two training days.
training.scheduleRequired: Choose at least two training days.
training.scheduleTooMany: Choose no more than six training days.
training.qualityTooMany: Choose one quality day at most.
training.goalError: The training goal could not be saved.
training.regenerateCopy: Manual session edits stay in place.
training.planCopy: A day-by-day plan based on your goal and the pace guide below.
training.noSessionsCopy: Save a goal to generate your training calendar.
training.sessionError: The session could not be updated.
training.predictionTitle: A range to guide your target
training.predictionCaution: Use this as a planning signal, not a promise. The range reflects {confidence} confidence and may move as more runs are recorded.
training.noPrediction: A prediction will appear after Runwise has enough real run history.
training.paceTitle: Keep each effort in its lane
training.paceCopy: Suggested training paces derived from your plan and recent records.
training.generatedEasy: Easy aerobic run at a conversational effort.
training.generatedEasyLimited: Easy aerobic run at a conversational effort. Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedLong: Long relaxed run; keep the effort easy and even.
training.generatedLongLimited: Long relaxed run; keep the effort easy and even. Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedQualityTempo: Warm up 10 min; 3 x 5 min at tempo pace with 2 min easy recovery; cool down 10 min.
training.generatedQualityTempoLimited: Warm up 10 min; 3 x 5 min at tempo pace with 2 min easy recovery; cool down 10 min. Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedQualityInterval: Warm up 10 min; 6 x 1 min at interval pace with 2 min easy recovery; cool down 10 min.
training.generatedQualityIntervalLimited: Warm up 10 min; 6 x 1 min at interval pace with 2 min easy recovery; cool down 10 min. Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedQualityTaper: Warm up 10 min; 3 x 2 min at quality pace with easy recovery; cool down 10 min.
training.generatedQualityTaperLimited: Warm up 10 min; 3 x 2 min at quality pace with easy recovery; cool down 10 min. Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedQualityDynamic: Warm up {warmup}; {reps} x {work} at {kind} pace with {recovery} recovery; cool down {cooldown}; stay within the planned distance.{limited}
training.limitedHistory: Limited history: start conservatively and adjust by feel.
training.generatedRace: Race day: run the planned distance and use the target as a guide.
training.calendarEmpty: Your recorded runs and upcoming sessions will appear here.
training.loadError: Training data could not be loaded.
training.notConfigured: Set a race goal to generate your training plan.
